title: The Jungle
subtitle: Gold Deluxe Edition
author: Upton Sinclair
description: The Jungle, when published in serial form in 1905, was a third longer than the censored commercial edition published in book form the following year. That removed business edition removed much of the ethnic flavor from the original, as well as some of the most gruesome depictions of the meat-packing industry and much of Sinclair's sharpest social and political commentary.
